name: convention-manifest-entry-directory
description: A string under a manifest entry key of an applied convention row names the tool's entries: a directory of entries or one entry, its extension optional. A string naming build output reads back through the emit mappings to the source that emits it, so the command and the hook it names are roots and a module nothing names is reported. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named oclif for the package @oclif/core whose manifest entry keys are oclif.commands, naming a directory, and oclif.hooks, naming files, its range holding the installed version.
